items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Important Note:** This competition is a twin competition alongside [Marrickville Autumn Sunday 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleAutumnSunday2021). Competitors are permitted to attend **ONLY ONE of these competitions**. More information can be found on the Information tab. Please also read the Information tab carefully to make sure you understand the COVID-safe requirements. Guests are limited to strictly one per competitor. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
